title: Drop statistics from the domain type while keeping the persisted field
outcome: The domain model no longer claims that stored statistics are authoritative, while the persisted field stays available for a future materialization decision.
acceptanceCriteria: The stats arrays are removed from the Game domain type and from the *View response schemas; nothing reads or writes them.
The Mongoose schema keeps the stats field with a comment recording that it has no writer and why it was kept.
Games recorded before this Change still display correct statistics, because the values are derived from their entries rather than read from the stored field.
pnpm build succeeds with no remaining reference to the stored statistics.
